cues.text: Cover, frame one, no host: a workbench phone ringing in the sun, a robot face on its screen, the wall clock at 2:00 PM; plate "AI answering your phone?" / "Not at 2 PM." with EXAMPLE. On "receptionist" cut in close on the robot face, its speech bubble HELLO, I'M AN AI. Snow comes in.
Cut to the clock big, 2:00 PM; NOT AT 2 PM stamps in red.
Our own day street: a roof with a ladder, the phone buzzing in the truck below, ring arcs. "Phone rings on the roof."
The phone screen turns to VOICEMAIL; the sky steps to night on "night", a moon, CALL BACK lights on the phone.
The chat set in the truck: pitch notifications drop in (EXAMPLE, no company named): "Let a robot answer your phone?", "Try our AI receptionist!", a third.

Mosaic to the forum card: JOBBER COMMUNITY, OWNER FORUM; a post card types in: "Hardly anyone stays once they hear it's AI." Tag: one owner who runs it after hours, Nov 2026 (paraphrase card, no name).
CALLER LEFT stamps over the post.
The gauge: COMFORTABLE WITH AI BOOKING; the needle climbs and settles on 36 on "thirty-six"; the hero 36% under the hub. Tag: ACHR News, Oct 20, 2026; 782 homeowners, spring 2026.
The 36% lands; the red zone above it reads NOT COMFORTABLE.
The flap board, 2:00 PM CALL: rows land one by one: ROBOT ANSWERS, CALLER CAN HANG UP, NEXT SHOP RINGS. EXAMPLE.
The last row lands in red.
Day and night split: left the sun, YOU on the phone; right the moon, the robot on the phone. On "night" the night half lights.
BETTER VOICEMAIL stamps on the night half.
The split settles: DAY: YOU / NIGHT: AI, both lit.
The setup card slides up (ITEM GET): AFTER HOURS SETUP, step 1 "Carrier: send calls to AI after hours only" lights.
Step 2 "Greeting: say it's AI" lights; the Jobber help tag under it: "We encourage you to let callers know" / Jobber help, updated Oct 28, 2026.
The greeting, word for word, held: "You've reached us after hours. I'm our AI assistant. I can book you for tomorrow or take the details now." (EXAMPLE); step 3 "Test call tonight: no heat" lights.
Back on the day street, the sun up: "2 PM: THEY WANT YOU." Snow points at the phone.
The versus screen: ROBOT against BEEP; VS slams; WIN stamps on ROBOT on "beep". Then the end card with the send line.
